note: Adapted from the original English description of Snyder 1924 (new species, Leucotermes longiceps Snyder, type locality Cuyabá/Coxipó, Brazil; later placed in Heterotermes). The original states that the species is known only from the soldier caste (known only from the soldier caste), and the measurements are single values.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: New species (originally Leucotermes longiceps, later placed in Heterotermes), known only from the soldier. Soldier head pale yellowish brown and slender, more than 2 times as long as wide, the sides slightly concave in the middle, with only a few scattered long hairs; antennae 17-segmented; mandibles dark chestnut brown to black, slender, curved inwards at the tip; postmentum slender and long, the anterior part 2 times as wide as the middle; pronotum white with a yellow tinge, nearly heart-shaped, both anterior and posterior margins concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, slender, more than 2 times as long as wide, the sides slightly concave in the middle, with only a few scattered long hairs. Antennae white with a yellow tinge, 17-segmented, widening towards the tip, with short hairs; the third segment nearly club-shaped, shorter than the second and fourth. Labrum pale yellow, pointed at the tip, with long hairs, widest in the middle. Mandibles dark chestnut brown to black, slender, curved inwards at the tip. Postmentum slender and long, the anterior part 2 times as wide as the middle. Pronotum white with a yellow tinge, nearly heart-shaped, with long hairs, both anterior and posterior margins concave; the sides rounded and narrowing posteriorly. Legs white with a yellow tinge, slender and long. Abdomen white with a yellow tinge, with dense long hairs. Cerci long and distinct. Measurements: soldier total length 6.75; head length with mandibles 3.2; head length without mandibles (to the anterior margin) 2.2; head length (to the tip of the labrum) 2.775; pronotum length 0.5; left mandible length 1.1; hind tibia length 0.708; head width 1; pronotum width 0.8.
